_README: Schools held OFF the site by a human decision, regardless of what the sweep says.
The sweep probes ONE course and asks whether the answer looks sane. That catches a dead
host; it does not catch an adapter that returns confident, wrong data. ops/gate.py goes
deeper (both open AND full states required, section-collapse keying, term freshness) and
can fail a school the sweep happily marks OK — and the next sweep would put it straight
back on the site. This file outranks the sweep so that cannot happen.
Remove an entry only when the defect is FIXED and ops/gate.py passes the school.
Each entry states the defect and what a student would experience, because 'blocked' with
no reason becomes permanent by default once nobody remembers why.

jacksonmi.reason: Feed accumulates three terms at once (26/SUM, 26/FAL, 27/SPR) and the adapter keys sections by number, so 88 records collapse to 50 and 24 section numbers appear more than once. ENG-131-04 exists as Spring-27 (Open, 14 seats) AND Fall-26 (Waitlisted, 1 seat); whichever survives the collapse is arbitrary. A student would either be told a seat opened in a term they are not registering for, or never told about a real one in the term they are. Verified 2026-08-04.
jacksonmi.fix: Key sections by their unique Id, and filter the feed to the current term before parsing — see the RCCD accumulating-feed lesson. Then run: python3 ops/gate.py jacksonmi
